note: Review: Nov 3 item given specific attribution (Liberation, Ouest-France); FSU Bluesky item kept; Saint-Brieuc item checked against Ouest-France

ops.find: France prepares for a nationwide strike and convergence

event.label: reported
event.text: France: ahead of the November 5 strike, Libération reports that the SNCF expects disruption on most lines while the RATP expects relatively normal traffic, and Ouest-France reports that in Lorient the unions' march will start from a hospital car park, students plan to block a university building and almost all public schools are disrupted.

ops.find: The FSU teachers' union stated on Bluesky

event.label: alleged
event.text: The FSU teachers' union stated on Bluesky that the general secretary of the Italian trade union FLC CGIL expressed support for the November 5 mobilization and announced that Italian students and education personnel will mobilize on November 20 to defend public education.

event.label: reported
event.text: The CGT, FSU, FO and Solidaires unions said they filed an urgent court appeal (référé-liberté) on the morning of November 4 over the Saint-Brieuc march route, which the prefecture then approved; Ouest-France reports the unions questioned the delay and ‘difficulties of dialogue’, saying they had declared the route on October 19.
